text: The stock market just got absolutely crushed yesterday.
The Nasdaq dropped five point five percent, and the S&P 500 fell over four percent.
Democrats just won big in the midterm elections, and now investors are worried that tougher AI regulations could slow down the massive expansion of AI data centers.
Because companies are spending billions of dollars building AI infrastructure, and investors are already questioning whether those investments will pay off.
Those fears added even more pressure to tech stocks, with Nvidia falling over nine percent.
But while some investors are panic selling, I'm doing the complete opposite.
I actually bought more SoFi stock because I believe in its long-term potential.
Now, I'm only twenty-two, and I'm still learning about investing.
I know that just because a stock drops doesn't mean it's a bargain.
It could fall even further, but I'm sticking to my long-term investing plan.
Is this a buying opportunity, or is the market about to get even worse?
